observations.trace: GpuGroom and GpuGuides expose independent count, points, positions and attributes. Both read paths call read_strands, which reads vectors and then indexes positions[s*points+j] and attributes[s] without checking both lengths; Strands::with_capacity also asserts points>=2.
observations.remaining: Original Adler q160 and delegate753 already identified this conditional aggregate. Actual malformed producers, successful buffer readback, native extents and exact aliases remain open; no readback or panic ran.

observations.trace: read_words copies one requested word per input and returns an error if the read vector is too short, then returns exactly words.len values. Thus read_word[0] and the earlier guide count indexes are not short solely after a successful read_words with the corresponding input list. Hair headless_context maps the native adapter error and uses the HairGpuError Device conversion for request_device.
observations.remaining: Delegate753 already recorded the successful-length invariant. Native copy bounds and device failures are separate; the headless adapter/device path must not be conflated with wildcard cause erasure in WgpuContext.open. No copy, request or error was executed.

observations.trace: set_head_mesh sizes neighbors from Surface.positions then indexes neighbors[a] for each distinct pair of triangle indices. Surface.new reads its initial indices, but positions, normals and triangles are public and can be changed independently later.
observations.remaining: A mutated triangle referring outside positions can reach an unchecked neighbor index; this is conditional on a malformed or mutated Surface and no actual caller or panic is shown. The prior delegate753 explicitly raised the same admission question.

observations.trace: upload accepts Strands and uploads empty vectors as four default elements. Strands.bounds and the upload root-bounds loop initialize to positive/negative infinity and do not replace them when there are no points or strands. GpuLods.lods_against can use groom.bounds as the source of its grid.
observations.remaining: This is conditional on empty input and successful native buffer setup; valid empty-groom and downstream grid policy remain unresolved. Delegate753 already noted the empty root bounds. No upload, grid or GPU was run.

observations.trace: hair headless_context creates a device then wraps it through WgpuContext.from_parts, which selects Uncaptured validation observation. That differs from the native WgpuContext.open owned-device selection; the earlier reviewer already noted it. GpuGroomer.finish ignores the Result of device.poll, whose pinned wgpu signature returns PollStatus or PollError.
observations.remaining: Whether headless-owned contexts should capture scopes and whether finish must report errors are policy questions; no native validation, polling or failure was observed. The finish operation is distinct from WgpuContext.submitted_work_done.

observations.trace: upload casts Strands.len and points from usize to u32 independently of uploaded vector lengths. The source contains GPU tests with explicit absent-device skip branches.
observations.remaining: Large counts require enough host memory and successful prior operations; an ordinary truncation is not claimed. All test code was only read: no pass, skip, device or runtime validation is inferred.
